description: Decision tree for auto-assigning a persona to a new lead based on their Airtable record data. Rules are evaluated in priority order (lowest number first). First matching rule wins.

rules.description: Company or organization running a branded podcast for thought leadership
Has no podcast yet and is ready to launch from scratch
Has an active podcast, uploads frequently, wants to professionalize and scale
Social media content creator expanding to podcasting, budget-conscious, volume-focused
rules.make_condition_expression: {{lead.budget}} = 'Under $500/mo' OR ({{lead.budget}} = '$500-$1,000/mo' AND ({{lead.service_interest}} CONTAINS 'Publishing' OR {{lead.service_interest}} CONTAINS 'Content Research'))

rules.description: Default persona — solo founder or small biz owner who wants a podcast without the workload

implementation_notes: Evaluate rules in priority order (1 → 5). Stop at first match.
In Make.com Scenario 07, use a Router module with one filter per rule.
After persona is matched, write Persona Type and Persona ID back to the Airtable Leads record.
If no rule matches (data is incomplete), fall back to P01 — The Busy Entrepreneur.
Persona assignment runs immediately after lead scoring in Scenario 01 or as a standalone Scenario 07.
